title: It Infrastructure Engineer
company: GVK Emergency Management and Research Institute (GVK EMRI)
description:
Key Responsibilities 
 1. IT Support & Troubleshooting 
 Provide first-level technical support for hospital staff on IT-related issues. Troubleshoot hardware, software, printer, and system problems. Install and configure desktops, laptops, and peripheral devices. 
 2. Network & Infrastructure Support 
 Support LAN/WAN connectivity across hospital departments. Monitor network performance and report issues to the IT team. Assist in maintaining network devices such as switches, routers, and access points. 
 3. System Administration Support 
 Assist in basic administration of Linux/Red Hat servers. Support database backups and routine system maintenance tasks. Monitor system performance and report irregularities. 
 4. IT Security & Data Protection 
 Follow hospital IT security policies and procedures. Assist in antivirus management, system updates, and patching. Support implementation of data security practices. 
 5. Documentation & Reporting 
 Maintain records of IT assets, incidents, and support requests. Assist in documenting IT procedures and troubleshooting guides.

Key Skills: Hardware Networking,Network Support,IT Support,IT Infrastructure,System Administration,Hardware Support,IT Operations,System
